subject: general
question: Which activity symbolizes the celebration of Uttarayan festival in Gujarat?
solution:
The correct answer is __**kite flying.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kite flying is the most popular activity during the Uttarayan festival in Gujarat.**
 
• **Uttarayan** is a festival celebrated in **Gujarat** to mark the** end of winter** and the start of the** **harvest season.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lighting of diyas is a common activity during Diwali, the festival of lights, which is celebrated in India in October or November.**
 
• Bursting crackers is a common activity during Diwali as well, but it is not associated with the **Uttarayan festival in Gujarat.**
 
• **Gold shopping** is not an activity associated with the Uttarayan festival in Gujarat, although it may be a popular activity during other festivals or occasions in India.
